rules.title: Obsolete SSL Protocol Version (SSL 2.0 / SSL 3.0)
rules.description: Observed obsolete SSL protocol version containing critical architectural vulnerabilities.
rules.remediation: Disable SSL 2.0 and SSL 3.0 across all mail services. Mandate TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3.

rules.title: Deprecated TLS Protocol Version (TLS 1.0 / TLS 1.1)
rules.description: Observed deprecated protocol version formally prohibited by RFC 8996.
rules.remediation: Disable TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1. Configure mail listeners to mandate TLS 1.2 minimum.

rules.title: TLS 1.2 Protocol Negotiated
rules.remediation: Maintain configuration; consider upgrading to TLS 1.3 for enhanced security.

rules.title: Modern TLS 1.3 Protocol Negotiated
rules.description: Observed modern TLS 1.3 protocol satisfying contemporary cryptographic standards.

rules.title: Suspected STARTTLS Stripping / Downgrade
rules.description: Observed STARTTLS advertised or requested followed by unencrypted plaintext continuation.
rules.remediation: Enforce mandatory TLS upgrade or switch to implicit TLS (Port 465/993/995).
